title: USB NPC Menu
script:
local P,U,Pl,V,R,RR,T=game:GetService("PathfindingService"),game:GetService("UserInputService"),game:GetService("Players"),game:GetService("VirtualUser"),game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"),game:GetService("RobloxReplicatedStorage"),game:GetService("TextChatService")
local p,sr,na,wa,aa,ca,ct,ac,ch=Pl.LocalPlayer,true,false,false,false,false,nil,nil,nil
local c=p.Character or p.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local h,r=c:WaitForChild("Humanoid"),c:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

-- INTEGRATED REQUESTED PHRASES BELOW
local ph,ig,sky,dq={
    "Fix Bedrock Mojang","Anti-Viral Spiral","Blingo Blizzard","Jarona","Hello traveler!","Just patrolling.","Greetings!","Stay safe out there."
},{
    "Greetings, friend!","Can I help you?","Welcome to our server!","State your business.","Ah, a fresh face!","Stay safe.","Nice gear!"
},{
    "Wow, look at the sky...","What a beautiful view.","Stunning scenery.","Appreciating the world.","Nice to pause and look up."
},{
    "Your current life is just a side quest; the main story begins when your eyes close forever.",
    "We are all blocks in a map someone else is building.",
    "Reality is merely an illusion, albeit a very persistent one.",
    "The world is a simulation, but the choices you make inside it are real.",
    "Time is an illusion. Yesterday is a configuration file, tomorrow is uncompiled code."
}

local sg=Instance.new("ScreenGui",p:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"))
sg.Name="USB_NPCSim"
sg.ResetOnSpawn=false

-- Increased frame height slightly to fit the new button nicely
local mf=Instance.new("Frame",sg)
mf.Size=UDim2.new(0,180,0,365)
mf.Position=UDim2.new(0.05,0,0.4,0)
mf.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(9,38,25)
mf.BorderSizePixel=0
mf.Active=true
mf.Draggable=true
Instance.new("UICorner",mf).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,4)
Instance.new("UIStroke",mf).Color=Color3.fromRGB(0,210,255)

local usbPlug=Instance.new("Frame",mf)
usbPlug.Size=UDim2.new(0,50,0,25)
usbPlug.Position=UDim2.new(0.5,0,0,0)
usbPlug.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0.5,1)
usbPlug.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(180,185,190)
usbPlug.BorderSizePixel=0
Instance.new("UIStroke",usbPlug).Color=Color3.fromRGB(120,125,130)
Instance.new("UICorner",usbPlug).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,4)

local function chle(x)
    local f=Instance.new("Frame",usbPlug)
    f.Size=UDim2.new(0,8,0,6)
    f.Position=UDim2.new(x,0,0.4,0)
    f.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5)
    f.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(50,50,50)
end
chle(0.25)
chle(0.75)

local tl=Instance.new("TextLabel",mf)
tl.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,35)
tl.Text="USB CORE"
tl.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(0,220,255)
tl.BackgroundTransparency=1
tl.Font=Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
tl.TextSize=16

local function cb(txt,y)
    local b=Instance.new("TextButton",mf)
    b.Size=UDim2.new(0.9,0,0,38)
    b.Position=UDim2.new(0.05,0,0,y)
    b.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(15,60,40)
    b.Text=txt
    b.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(180,240,255)
    b.Font=Enum.Font.SourceSansSemibold
    b.TextSize=14
    b.BorderSizePixel=0
    Instance.new("UIStroke",b).Color=Color3.fromRGB(0,140,180)
    Instance.new("UICorner",b).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,6)
    return b
end

local bW,bM,bA,bC,bDis,bD=cb("NPC Patrol: OFF",40),cb("Wall Avoidance: OFF",85),cb("Anti-AFK: OFF",130),cb("NPC Chat: OFF",175),cb("Discord Link",220),cb("Self Destruct Script",265)

-- Style Discord button slightly differently to stand out
bDis.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(35,85,120)
bDis.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(220,245,255)
bDis:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke").Color=Color3.fromRGB(0,160,220)

-- Style Self Destruct button
bD.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(110,25,25)
bD.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,220,220)
bD:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke").Color=Color3.fromRGB(180,40,40)

local footer=Instance.new("TextLabel",mf)
footer.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,25)
footer.Position=UDim2.new(0,0,1,-30)
footer.Text="NPC SIM v2.0"
footer.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(0,170,200)
footer.BackgroundTransparency=1
footer.Font=Enum.Font.SourceSansItalic
footer.TextSize=12

local function gRP()
    return Vector3.new(r.Position.X+math.random(-65,65),r.Position.Y,r.Position.Z+math.random(-65,65))
end

local function iWB()
    local rp=RaycastParams.new()
    rp.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    rp.FilterDescendantsInstances={c}
    local f=workspace:Raycast(r.Position,r.CFrame.LookVector*4.5,rp)
    return (f and f.Instance and f.Instance.CanCollide) and true or false
end

local function sCM(m)
    local ic=T:FindFirstChild("ChatInputBarConfiguration")
    if ic and ic.TargetTextChannel then
        ic.TargetTextChannel:SendAsync(m)
        return
    end
    local tc=T:FindFirstChild("TextChannels")
    local rg=tc and (tc:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral") or tc:FindFirstChild("RBXInGameChat"))
    if rg then
        rg:SendAsync(m)
        return
    end
    local le=R:FindFirstChild("DefaultChatSystemChatEvents") and R.DefaultChatSystemChatEvents:FindFirstChild("SayMessageRequest")
    if le then
        le:FireServer(m,"All")
    end
end

local function cAJ()
    local rp=RaycastParams.new()
    rp.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    rp.FilterDescendantsInstances={c}
    local f=workspace:Raycast(r.Position-Vector3.new(0,1,0),r.CFrame.LookVector*3.5,rp)
    if f and f.Instance and f.Instance.CanCollide then
        h.JumpPower=50
        h.Jump=true
        task.wait(0.2)
        h.JumpPower=0
    end
end

local function wTD(tP)
    if wa then
        local pth=P:CreatePath({AgentRadius=4.5,AgentHeight=5.5,AgentCanJump=true})
        local s,e=pcall(function()
            pth:ComputeAsync(r.Position,tP)
        end)
        if s and pth.Status==Enum.PathStatus.Success then
            local w=pth:GetWaypoints()
            for i=2,#w do
                if not na or not sr then break end
                if w[i].Action==Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump then
                    h.JumpPower=50
                    h.Jump=true
                    task.wait(0.1)
                    h.JumpPower=0
                end
                if iWB() then
                    cAJ()
                    if iWB() then
                        h:MoveTo(r.Position-(r.CFrame.LookVector*2))
                        task.wait(0.2)
                        break
                    end
                end
                h:MoveTo(w[i].Position)
                local cp,cn=false,nil
                cn=h.MoveToFinished:Connect(function()
                    cp=true
                end)
                local st=os.clock()
                while not cp and (os.clock()-st)<1.5 do
                    if iWB() then cAJ() break end
                    task.wait()
                end
                if cn then cn:Disconnect() end
                if iWB() then break end
            end
            return
        end
    end
    h:MoveTo(tP)
    local cp,cn=false,nil
    cn=h.MoveToFinished:Connect(function()
        cp=true
    end)
    local st=os.clock()
    while not cp and (os.clock()-st)<4 do
        if wa and iWB() then
            cAJ()
            if iWB() then break end
        end
        task.wait()
    end
    if cn then cn:Disconnect() end
end

local function aTS()
    if math.random(1,100)>15 then return end
    local st=os.clock()
    if ca then
        sCM(sky[math.random(1,#sky)])
    end
    while (os.clock()-st)<math.random(4,7) and na and sr do
        r.CFrame=r.CFrame:Lerp(CFrame.new(r.Position,r.Position+(r.CFrame.LookVector*10)+Vector3.new(0,15,0)),0.1)
        task.wait()
    end
end

local function cPS()
    if math.random(1,100)>3 then return end
    if ca then
        sCM("Oh No! I forgot something!")
    end
    h.WalkSpeed=26
    wTD(gRP())
    h.WalkSpeed=12
    task.wait(math.random(1,3))
end

local function cDE()
    if math.random(1,1000)~=1 then return end
    local plrs={}
    for _,v in pairs(Pl:GetPlayers()) do
        if v~=p and v.Character and v.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            table.insert(plrs,v.Character.HumanoidRootPart)
        end
    end
    if #plrs==0 then return end
    local target=plrs[math.random(1,#plrs)]
    wTD(target.Position+(target.CFrame.LookVector*3.5))
    local st=os.clock()
    while (os.clock()-st)<2 and na and sr do
        r.CFrame=r.CFrame:Lerp(CFrame.new(r.Position,Vector3.new(target.Position.X,r.Position.Y,target.Position.Z)),0.2)
        task.wait()
    end
    if ca then
        sCM(dq[math.random(1,#dq)])
    end
    task.wait(3.5)
end

local function tNP()
    while sr do
        if na then
            h.WalkSpeed=12
            wTD(gRP())
            aTS()
            cPS()
            cDE()
            task.wait(math.random(2,5))
        else
            task.wait(1)
        end
    end
end

-- Button Toggle Events
bW.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    na = not na
    bW.Text = na and "NPC Patrol: ON" or "NPC Patrol: OFF"
    bW.BackgroundColor3 = na and Color3.fromRGB(20,90,60) or Color3.fromRGB(15,60,40)
end)

bM.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    wa = not wa
    bM.Text = wa and "Wall Avoidance: ON" or "Wall Avoidance: OFF"
    bM.BackgroundColor3 = wa and Color3.fromRGB(20,90,60) or Color3.fromRGB(15,60,40)
end)

bA.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    aa = not aa
    bA.Text = aa and "Anti-AFK: ON" or "Anti-AFK: OFF"
    bA.BackgroundColor3 = aa and Color3.fromRGB(20,90,60) or Color3.fromRGB(15,60,40)
    if aa then
        task.spawn(function()
            while aa do
                V:Button2Down(Vector2.new(0,0),workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame)
                task.wait(1)
                V:Button2Up(Vector2.new(0,0),workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame)
                task.wait(30)
            end
        end)
    end
end)

bC.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    ca = not ca
    bC.Text = ca and "NPC Chat: ON" or "NPC Chat: OFF"
    bC.BackgroundColor3 = ca and Color3.fromRGB(20,90,60) or Color3.fromRGB(15,60,40)
    if ca then
        task.spawn(function()
            while ca do
                task.wait(math.random(15, 30))
                if ca and math.random(1, 2) == 1 then
                    sCM(ig[math.random(1, #ig)])
                end
            end
        end)
    end
end)

-- Discord Link Button Functionality
bDis.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    pcall(function()
        setclipboard("https://discord.gg/WgYEVxycDW")
    end)
    bDis.Text = "Link Copied!"
    task.wait(1.5)
    bDis.Text = "Discord Link"
end)

bD.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    sr = false
    sg:Destroy()
    if c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
        c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid").Health = 0
    end
end)

-- Start Patrol Thread
task.spawn(tNP)
features: NPC Patrol, Chat, Anti-AFK System, Wall Avoidance
